## Engineering standards

Follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/onculture-build/Onculture-landing-page/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md) and the pinned [.engineering-standards.json](https://github.com/onculture-build/Onculture-landing-page/blob/develop/.engineering-standards.json).

- Applicable control IDs and rationale:
- Checks run and exact results (include failures/skips):
- API, tenant, security/privacy, migration or rollout impact:
- UI state/accessibility verification, when relevant:
- Residual risks, existing gaps or approved exception/ADR:

- [ ] Existing components/infrastructure reused where applicable.
- [ ] Relevant behavior, failure and denied-access paths verified, or limitations stated.
- [ ] No secrets or real customer records in code, fixtures or evidence.
